description.zh:
主DNS服务器IP地址。

> 不设置会清空DNS配置。
description.en:
The IP address of the primary DNS server.

>  If you do not set this parameter, the IP address of the existing DNS server will be cleared.

description.zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed.

description.zh:
备DNS服务器IP地址。

> 不设置会清空备用DNS配置。
description.en:
The IP address of the secondary DNS server.

>  If you do not set this parameter, the IP address of the existing DNS server will be cleared.
The ID of the SAG instance.

description.zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号。
description.en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance.
